classifier_edge_bug_found_and_fixed: the first full N=700/arm run produced 2 (motion) and 3 (repaint_static) 'hits', ALL at the identical row range 9-16 in every case. Direct pixel inspection showed row 0 of every screenshot in this capture is a flat ~230-brightness 1px seam (a screenshot/iframe-boundingBox clip artifact, not game content) that skews Stage 1's smoothed vertical baseline near the top margin. Fixed by excluding a top/bottom margin (30px) from Stage 1 candidate detection; re-validated against the full 22-frame calibration corpus with NO change to any of those verdicts (still 3/3 true positives, 17/18 true negatives, the 1 known preseat_0 false positive unchanged). Re-running classification after the fix gave 0/700 raw Stage-1 candidates in BOTH arms (not just 0 after cross-validation -- 0 even before it).
